ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply; see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu This site-based course is for students in the EOL Oak Brook CCEL (Higher Ed) Doctoral cohort. Class sessions will be held on the Urbana campus at the College of Education in room 242 on these weekends and times - Jan 23 & 24, Feb 20 & 21, Mar 20 & 21, April 24 & 25; Fridays 5 to 9pm; Saturdays 8am to 5pm. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veteransø grants, etc.) and waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC. The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois Board of Trustees.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $441.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
